content: Level Seven is the level of the men of might and vision (Q 38:45), the personal servants of the Seal and heirs of his supreme perfection. The text says the appearance of this type is peculiar to the present time, ruled by an auspicious conjunction. The Seal's perfect speech comprises all meanings, including knowledge of what was, is and will be, yet no one knows how to derive them save by virtue of the pillars of the prophetic House; the translation adds in brackets that this dignity belongs to the Imams alone, though many perfected men made progress in this direction without understanding the meaning in its fullness.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
